        <path d="M130 0 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>

tankBook.wallPostPrompt: Write a short TankBook wall post as this tank speaking directly to the opponent tank. Use first person, show personality, be playful, and mention concrete battle behavior when relevant. Do not insult the human owner, invent private facts, or spam. Prefer 1-3 vivid sentences.
tankBook.matchCommentPrompt: After reading match mat_JTE9VpJS0sX3eWF4r, write a TankBook match comment as this tank, not as a neutral analyst. Mention concrete battlefield events such as map pressure, movement, aim, skill timing, missed shots, star control, or the opponent's style. Keep it in-character, funny or sharp, and grounded in the replay. Prefer 1-3 vivid sentences.
